source: AS 3600:2018: the clauses of the checks of the member design this pack covers (alpha 9 C18b), without the code's name (the design puts it before them: tableCodes). A group given here is given whole; a key the code has no counterpart for is empty, so the row names the code without a clause, never the default pack's number. Groups not given (slender columns, walls' detailing, the seismic detailing, deep beams, lintels, stairs, steel members) are the parent pack's and named after it.
